axes_source: Read from data/brands/warp.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #F7F5F0 and the canvas #2B2622; contrast from the ink #F7F5F0 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #F7F5F0; density from its 2px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #F7F5F0 reaches 13.74:1 on the canvas #2B2622, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
